events.title: Closest to Jupiter
events.text: It passes 280 000 km from Jupiter, having found a faint ring around the planet.

events.title: The Pale Blue Dot
events.text: From 6 billion km it photographs Earth as a point of light about a pixel in size.

events.title: The most distant thing we made
events.text: At 69.4 astronomical units from the Sun it overtakes Pioneer 10 as the most distant human-made object.

events.title: Closest to Uranus
events.text: It passes 81 500 km from Uranus, still the only spacecraft to have been there, and finds ten new moons.

events.title: Launch
events.text: New Horizons leaves Cape Canaveral on an Atlas V 551.

events.title: Jupiter's push
events.text: It swings past Jupiter for a gravity assist that shortens the trip to Pluto by three years.

events.title: Past Venus
events.text: It passes Venus 16 000 km up, the first of three gravity assists.

events.title: Past Mars
events.text: It passes within 542 km of the surface of Mars, which bends its path outwards.

events.title: Into orbit round Ceres
events.text: It enters its first orbit round the dwarf planet Ceres.

events.title: Launch
events.text: Pioneer 10 leaves Cape Canaveral on an Atlas-Centaur, the first spacecraft sent to the outer Solar System.

events.title: The last signal
events.text: Its last signal is received, sent from 12.23 billion km away.

events.title: Past the orbit of Neptune
events.text: It crosses the orbit of Neptune, the fourth spacecraft to do so.

events.title: Arrival at L2
events.text: It arrives at L2, 1.5 million km from Earth.

events.title: Launch
events.text: NEAR leaves Earth for the asteroid Eros.

events.title: Back past Earth
events.text: It swings past Earth for a gravity assist, 540 km away at its closest.

events.title: Into orbit round Eros
events.text: NEAR goes into orbit round the asteroid Eros.

events.title: Down on Eros
events.text: At the end of its mission it is set down on the surface of Eros, and goes on sending for two weeks.

events.title: Launch
events.text: Stardust leaves Earth for comet Wild 2.

events.title: Past Tempel 1
events.text: On a second mission it passes comet Tempel 1, the comet Deep Impact struck.

events.title: Landing in Jezero
events.text: The rover lands in Jezero crater after a seven-month cruise. The time is when the signal reached Earth.
